reviewed_by: Claude Code, at the operator's request to drop the deployer's CI evidence requirement
reason: The deployer's prepare required a successful main push CI run for every commit since the live release. Pull requests already merge only after their CI passes, and main push runs share a cancel-in-progress group, so back-to-back merges cancelled each other's evidence and blocked deploys. prepare now skips CI lookups by default (receipt ci_acceptance null with a reason) and --require-ci-evidence or --ci-run-id restores the check. Selected: the deployer CI-default and prebuild suites (updated for the new default plus a test pinning it) and the deployer protocol suite (CLI).
exclusions: Only scripts/simulation/nebula_deployer.py and its tests change; no Core, UI or workflow code, so frontend, native and Playwright selections are empty and LAN validation does not apply.
